visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair wearing a dark brown ribbed sweater stands in front of a Starbucks storefront in a bright shopping mall. He holds a green matcha Frappuccino and smiles widely at the camera. The background displays the Starbucks logo and a variety of merchandise on wooden shelves. He gestures enthusiastically, pointing at the drink while yellow and white text overlays appear on the screen to introduce the product. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the beverage, showcasing the green blended liquid and whipped cream topped with matcha cookie crumbles. This is followed by a screen capture of social media posts in Japanese discussing the drink's popularity. The man then sips the drink through a green straw, looking pleasantly surprised as pink heart emojis float around his face. We see shots of the drink being prepared, with green powder scooped and toppings added over the whipped cream. (3) The man continues his review, holding the drink up to show the texture of the cream and the green tea sediment at the bottom of the cup. He stands in the same well-lit mall environment, looking directly into the camera with a friendly and persuasive expression. The video concludes with a close-up of the drink's top view and the man giving a final recommendation while more informational text regarding the sale dates scrolls across the bottom.
